# #474 John Skogman: Så agerar jag när börsen faller

**Feed**: avanzapodden  
**Published**: 2026-11-10  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Guest John Skogman discusses how to act during sharp sell-offs. A US midterm result that hurt the AI and datacenter trade drove the Nasdaq 100 down 5% and semiconductors down 12%, while the OMXS30 held flat. He favours buying small baskets of unrelated, beaten-down stocks rather than rushing into collapsing US tech. He is bullish on Swedish real estate and preference shares, negative on Engcon, sold his Svevik IPO shares and pitches Salix (the Volati spin-off) as a buy. In the closing segment, Placera analyst Daniel gives Industrivärden a neutral rating and Paradox a buy.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ ENGCON-B — Engcon | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Guest says the US expansion story is dead after the 18-19% drop. The stock is not even cheap now and he sees no recovery.

#### Reasoning

Skogman (guest) has never believed in Engcon: tiltrotators are a Scandinavian niche, like the cheese slicer, with no global adoption. The report showed poor growth and weak US orders, undermining the US takeover narrative. Even after the fall he does not see the stock as cheap and regrets not shorting it.

#### Sell Triggers

- US order intake accelerates
- tiltrotator adoption outside Scandinavia becomes evident

> *"den är inte ens billig nu och jag ser absolut ingen att det ska repa sig, just eftersom jag aldrig har trott på det"*

---

### 🟢 SAGA-D — Sagax | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest bought D-shares on leverage when yields spiked and is bullish on beaten-down Swedish real estate.

#### Reasoning

Skogman sees a buying opportunity across Swedish property stocks after a long slump. Property is listed at roughly half its real-world value, and Swedish rates are not high. His leveraged buy of Sagax D-shares during the yield spike paid off as rates eased.

#### Sell Triggers

- rates rise sharply again
- property values fall further

> *"definitivt tror jag på fastighetsbolagen som har haft det väldigt, väldigt tufft under en längre period"*

---

### ⛔ CAST — Castellum | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Guest suggests perhaps leaving Castellum, which sold properties for buybacks, in favour of more beaten-down peers.

#### Reasoning

Within a sector he likes, Skogman prefers names that have fallen more over Castellum. Castellum has already monetised properties to buy back shares, which he sees as leaving less upside.

#### Sell Triggers

- Castellum discount to NAV widens again

> *"kanske till och med att man ska överge Kastöllen som har sålt iväg alla sina fastigheter för återköp av aktier"*

---

### 🟠 SKIS-B — Skistar | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Up from 160 to 204 kronor on a seasonal pattern. Guest sees a possible short after the December dividend.

#### Reasoning

Skogman holds Skistar in his dividend portfolio but notes the brutal run-up driven by the 'buy after summer, sell into winter' seasonality. He floats a short once the December dividend is paid and the hype fades.

#### Sell Triggers

- strong booking data extends momentum

> *"Det är en aktie som skulle kunna vara intressant för en blankning här, kanske efter utdelningen i december"*

---

### 🟡 INDU-C — Industrivärden | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Placera analyst Daniel rates it neutral: a 5% NAV premium with no clear justification and middling views on the holdings.

#### Reasoning

Cited Placera analyst view: all holdings are listed and can be replicated directly, and there is no value-creating trading. Industrivärden acts as a Swedish institution, not a return-maximising allocator, and a premium is unwarranted. Holders using it as a fund alternative need not sell, but it is unlikely to beat the market over a year.

#### Sell Triggers

- premium to NAV expands further
- holdings outlook deteriorates

> *"vi ser inget extra lockande med aktien just nu"*

---

### 🟢 PDX — Paradox Interactive | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Placera rates it a buy: a stable DLC revenue base, with upside if upcoming titles such as Lego Skylines succeed.

#### Reasoning

Cited Placera analyst view: complex strategy games create long-lived players and recurring DLC revenue, a stable base despite years of failed launches. The stock is down 12% this year. A turnaround needs successful new releases to rebuild player and investor trust; Europa Universalis is still salvageable.

#### Sell Triggers

- upcoming launches such as Lego Skylines flop
- further studio closures or write-downs

---

### 🟢 ESSITY-B — Essity | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Placera has buy ratings on Essity, an Industrivärden holding. It is also a top holding in Skogman's portfolio.

#### Reasoning

Placera analyst Daniel says they hold buy ratings on two of Industrivärden's holdings, Essity and Skanska. No detailed thesis was given in the episode.

#### Sell Triggers

- Placera downgrades the rating

> *"Vi har köpråd på två av deras innehav. Det är Essity och Skanska"*

---

### 🟢 SKA-B — Skanska | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Placera has a buy rating on Skanska, an Industrivärden holding.

#### Reasoning

Cited Placera analyst buy rating, mentioned in passing during the Industrivärden analysis. No detailed thesis was given.

#### Sell Triggers

- Placera downgrades the rating

> *"Vi har köpråd på två av deras innehav. Det är Essity och Skanska"*
